notes: Each contract's runtime as forge builds it (solc 0.8.28, contracts/pool-evm/foundry.toml): its length, the keccak256 of the runtime with every immutable's 32 bytes zeroed, and each immutable's start offsets. Written by contracts/pool-evm/script/deploy.mjs --write-build; test/deploy.test.mjs fails when forge's output differs; CI runs it after its forge test, with the forge CI installs (1.7.1). Forge 1.7.1 and 1.8.6 both build these bytes (solc 0.8.28 does the compiling): the test passed on 1.7.1 and the dry run, whose deploy.mjs refuses a build that differs, ran on 1.8.6, 2026-11-03. SellDelegate rebuilt for card evm-sell-v4 (constructor(IWETH, IPoolManager)) with forge 1.7.1, the version CI installs, on 2026-11-04, and again for card evm-selldelegate-exact-debit (W's balance of the token falls by exactly the amount) with forge 1.7.1 on 2026-11-04, and for pool review round 2 (R-3: WETH is read only for a route that can pay in it) on 2026-11-05. A contract with a sell method records its selector (`sell`, from forge's methodIdentifiers); each frozen SellDelegate records the one its deployed code dispatches (the ten-field sell's PUSH4 in eth_getCode at every frozen address on both testnets, base-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com and robinhood-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com, 2026-11-06).

SellDelegate.note: The v1 sell delegate (constructor(IWETH), one immutable: WETH), as this file pinned it before e9f6ff9. A deployed contract here has no upgrade path, so its code stays this build. It is checked only at the addresses in `at`, the pool-evm-deploy runs' delegates, which the kit pins until it moves to the evm-sell-v4 delegate; any other address, and every contract a run deploys now, is checked against `contracts`. deploy.mjs --write-build keeps this map as it is.

SellDelegate.v4.note: The evm-sell-v4 sell delegate (constructor(IWETH, IPoolManager)), as this file pinned it before card evm-selldelegate-exact-debit added the exact-debit check. Deployed with no upgrade path, so its code stays this build; it is checked only at the addresses in `at`, the evm-sell-v4 redeploys (scripts/live-checks/evm-sell-v4.<chain>.json), which the kit pinned until that card moved the pins. deploy.mjs --write-build keeps this map as it is.

SellDelegate.exact-debit.note: The evm-selldelegate-exact-debit sell delegate (constructor(IWETH, IPoolManager), with the exact-debit check), as this file pinned it before pool review round 2 (R-3: WETH read only for a route that can pay in it). Deployed with no upgrade path, so its code stays this build; it is checked only at the addresses in `at`, the evm-selldelegate-exact-debit redeploys (scripts/live-checks/evm-selldelegate-exact-debit.<chain>.json), which the kit pinned until card evm-testnet-delegate-review3 moved the pins to its redeploys at the pool-review-3 build (this build dispatches the 10-field sell 0xbea5695c). A kit pin is held to the current build (`contracts`), never to a frozen one (evm-venues-pin). deploy.mjs --write-build keeps this map as it is.
